title: Copilot local app data
whyItMatters: The Copilot app keeps local session state and browsing data alongside the account's chat history. It shows the app was used on this machine.
source: AI forensics handbook (urock-ailab.github.io/forensics-handbook/ai/02-artifacts/chat-services/copilot/windows.html): Store app data under %LOCALAPPDATA%/Packages/Microsoft.Copilot_*
notes: source uncertain: Microsoft documents Copilot chat history as account/cloud based and publishes no local history path. The Store app uses %LOCALAPPDATA%/Packages/Microsoft.Copilot_*; the older web experience used Microsoft.WindowsCopilot_*, which this glob does not match. Microsoft Q&A answers also name %LOCALAPPDATA%/Microsoft/Copilot as a cache folder; the suffix varies by build. Windows 11 22H2+. Metadata only.

cleanup.exportFirst: Download or read your Copilot activity history in the Microsoft privacy dashboard first; most of it is stored with your account, not only on this PC.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of the Microsoft Copilot app on this PC so the account keeps no signed-in session here.
steps: Sign out of the Copilot app on this PC.
Uninstall the Copilot app from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the app data folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes the Copilot app and its local state from this PC. Chats saved with your Microsoft account stay there until you delete them in the privacy dashboard.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Manage your Copilot activity history in the privacy dashboard: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/privacy/manage-your-copilot-activity-history-in-the-privacy-dashboard
